# laravel_cloud_database (Resource)

Manages a database (schema) within a Laravel Cloud database cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Database cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Database name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Database status.

## Import

A schema is only addressable through its cluster, so the import ID is
`<cluster_id>:<database_id>` — not the database id on its own:

```shell
terraform import laravel_cloud_database.db db-abc123:db-schema-def456
```
